summary: Recent updates in the Canvas tests area have focused on improving the reliability and security of graphics rendering in Firefox. One significant change is the **enabled protection for WebGL vendor and renderer information while using Private Browsing Mode (PBM)**, enhancing user privacy by preventing tracking of graphics hardware details. Additionally, updates to the ANGLE (Almost Native Graphics Layer Engine) component help maintain consistency in testing by ensuring that the latest known rendering conditions are accurately reflected in the tests. These changes collectively strengthen Firefox's graphics capabilities while safeguarding user information during private sessions.
